name: Algebraic Interpolation Obfuscation
description: Replaces a simple quadratic formula with a higher-degree polynomial (cubic) constructed via interpolation to yield the exact same logical constraints on the restricted domain {1, 2}. Because the maximum value is unique to the valid state (c_u != c_v), the sum condition strictly enforces bipartiteness, but models relying on pattern matching will fail to recognize the underlying 2-coloring structure due to the complex algebraic appearance.
